title: Spikers' Turf: Criss Cross claims top seed after rout of 3B
summary: Criss Cross dismantled 3B, 25-13, 25-15, 25-13, to claim the top seed in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
